building.name: 343 Sansome Street
building.architect: Philip Johnson and John Burgee Architects (15-story tower addition)

public_open_space.name: 343 Sansome
public_open_space.location: 15th floor terrace, and on top of the "old office tower" (could be one and the same). Also behind the building Leidesdorff Street, the street is closed during lunch hours
public_open_space.description: This fifteenth floor open space has excellent views of surrounding buildings and streets, as well as the San Francisco Bay. It has various types of seating and landscaping. It also has art in the form of a large sundial.
public_open_space.landscaping: Abundant flower planters, 6 shading trees, interesting paving and art, great views
public_open_space.seating: 10 tables with 20 movable chairs, 48 linear bench seats
public_open_space.restrooms: Yes. Must ask lobby attendant for key
public_open_space.signage: yes, at both entrances. It does not have features listed on the sign. Does have the logo.

public_art.title: Four Seasons
public_art.access: artwork and open space are accessible from 9-5
public_art.detail: The tiled obelisk stands at the center of the 15th-floor roof terrace and was funded through San Francisco's 1% for Art program combined with the POPOS requirement.

public_art.title: L'Octagon
public_art.access: artwork and open space are accessible from 9-5
public_art.detail: Belgian sculptor Pol Bury (April 26, 1922 - September 28, 2005) began his career as a painter associated with the Jeune Peinture Belge and CoBrA groups before becoming known for kinetic sculpture.
